IF THIS TRIGGERS THEN BUMBLEBEE WONT PLAY ROAR REACT DIALOG IN IMPACT

int.text: Deploying healing charges! Just be near them when they detonate!
Really? What was your first clue -- the total devastation?

fra.text: Vous entendez ça ? Je le sens mal.

int.text: My weapons aren't hurting him at all!
What's happening to his sides? They're changing!
YES! We did it! We're WINNING!

fra.text: OUAIS ! On a réussi ! On va GAGNER !

int.text: We've barely even slowed him down!

fra.text: Nos attaques l'ont à peine ralenti !

int.text: You think that hunk of junk could survive a crash from orbit?

fra.text: Tu crois vraiment que ce tas de ferraille a pu survire à un tel crash !?

int.text: You heard Silverbolt -- his armor's too tough!

fra.text: T'as pas écouté Silverbolt ? Son armure est trop épaisse !

int.text: I think we just made him angry.
Look out! Here comes another tail attack!

fra.text: Attention ! Il va encore utiliser sa queue !

int.text: He's still got the same problem -- too much heat build-up. Aim for those dissipation coils on his ribs!
He's not as tough as he lets on!
Those power cores on his back look vulnerable!

fra.text: Ces noyaux énergétiques sur son dos ont l'air vulnérables !

int.text: Look!  I think his shoulder cannons are overheating! If we can cause them to overload, it might destroy them!
Silverbolt, this is Optimus! We've pinpointed the crash site and are moving in for a visual. I want you on stand by in case there's any trouble.
Thanks for the tip, Silverbolt. We'll be careful.
I don't see any signs of Trypticon...and at his size, he'd be hard to miss.
Silverbolt! We've located Trypticon--uploading coordinates now!
Autobots! Focus all fire on Trypticon's dorsal power cores!
Autobots -- stay sharp! Don't let your guard down!
He can't be invincible. We're overlooking something!
Keep your optics open! He has to have some kind of weakness!
Autobots! Trypticon is about to attack! Be ready for anything!
We're following Ironhide's lead on this! Target those coils!
Keep it up, Autobots! We're hurting him!
Ironhide's right! We've got to figure out how to overload those cannons!
Hey, teamwork is fine with me!

fra.text: Je suis POUR le travail d'équipe !

int.text: Roger that, Optimus. We're jetting your way, but it will take us some time to reach you.
Trypticon is as tough as they come. If he is still alive, your weapons won't damage his armor. You'll have better luck targeting his weapon systems.
The cavalry has arrived! Air Raid, heal Prime and the others! Jetfire and I will cover you!
You thought you could destroy ME? You thought you could destroy TRYPTICON? Ha! Pathetic!

fra.text: Vous pensiez m'avoir détruit ? MOI !? Vous pensiez pouvoir détruire TRYPTICON ! Ah ! Ridicule !

int.text: You'll pay for that, you VERMIN!
You cannot escape from me! Now DIE!
ARRRRHHHHH! I'll CRUSH you! I'll crush you ALL!
You are fools. I cannot be defeated! WITNESS MY TRUE POWER!

fra.text: Pauvres idiots ! Je suis invincible ! ADMIREZ MA VRAIE PUISSANCE !

int.text: Abandon hope, vermin! Your death approaches!

fra.text: Abandonnez, minables ! Votre destruction est proche !

int.text: I'll grind you all to DUST!
You are wasting my time! Lie down and DIE!
You will SUFFER for this, Autobots!
